gui.xaeroheadtracker.title: Head Tracker Settings
gui.xaeroheadtracker.heads.tooltip: Shows the head of each player on the map.
gui.xaeroheadtracker.names.tooltip: Shows the name and status (Live, minutes since disconnection) of each player on the map.
gui.xaeroheadtracker.share.tooltip: Lets other players who have the mod see your position on their map.
gui.xaeroheadtracker.header_players: Players to show on the map
gui.xaeroheadtracker.help: Check the players you want to see on the map. Others are hidden.
gui.xaeroheadtracker.show_others.tooltip: Also shows every unchecked player, including those who join later.
